The candidate must hold a Postgraduate (PG) Degree in any field of Life Sciences (M.Sc.). The pay is Rs. 56,000 per month + HRA. content_sections.heading: MAHE Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) at a Glance

rows.details: Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), Manipal
Department of Surgical Oncology, Kasturba Medical College, Manipal
A Multimodal extra chromosomal DNA and Liquid Biopsy Prognostic Framework for Extranodal Extension-Positive Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma
Three years (initially for a period of one year, further extendable based on performance)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate (PG) Degree in any field of Life Sciences (M.Sc.). Candidates with experience working on Next Generation Sequencing Technologies will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 56,000 per month plus HRA. The project duration is three years, starting initially for a period of one year and further extendable based on performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAHE Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV with all requisite qualifications and experience details. Send the detailed CV by email to [email protected] on or before October 17, 2026. Mention the Job Code Application for PRS – I (NM) – Surgical Oncology, KMC, Manipal in the subject line of the email application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the interview date. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

rows.date: To be informed by e-mail to shortlisted candidates

rows.details: Visit the main portal of Manipal Academy of Higher Education
